items.question: What number of siddhi-attainment-rooted Kaula forms is declared to the fair-faced goddess?
items.inference: the verse declares eight siddhi-attainment-rooted Kaula forms to the goddess
uncertainties: vocative gender and case are inferred
items.plain_english: Eight, and siddhi-attainment-rooted Kaula, O fair-faced one.
